models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
Registered users for the Todo List application and core system authentication entity.

This table stores all individual user identities including their email, password hash for authentication, and timestamps for registration and account changes. Each user account is uniquely identified by its email address, which must be globally unique across all users. Passwords are securely stored as cryptographic hashes. Users are the sole owners of their Todos and may create, update, or delete their own tasks exclusively. No soft delete or status field is present; users are permanently removed upon deletion as per business requirement. Account creation and update times are recorded for audit and analytics purposes.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User email address for authentication and communication. Must be unique and comply with business email validation.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Cryptographic hash of user's password, never stored in plain text. Used for authentication only.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional display name for the user profile. Displayed in UI for personalization; may be null if not set.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the user's last profile/update action.

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description:
User session audit and authentication tracking for users in the Todo List system.

Each record represents a single login or active user session, associated with the owning user via foreign key. This table records essential context for security auditing: IP address, originating URL, referrer, creation and expiration times. No additional per-session business fields are present per the prescribed session pattern. Supports multiple concurrent sessions per user for use across devices. Sessions are used for login, token validation, and activity tracing, and managed through identity flows. Deletion is permanent and not recoverable.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning user of this session. Links each session to a registered user. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of user connection for this session audit.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL where the session was originated (e.g., login or API endpoint).

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL present at session initiation; may be used for additional auditing or context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp. Used for session audit and sorting.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session end/expiration timestamp; null if active. Set when session terminated by user/logout or expiry.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
A user's individual Todo task with tracked status and strict private ownership.

Each row represents a single Todo created and managed by a registered user. Todos contain a required title, an optional multi-line description, a completion status, and precise audit timestamps recording creation, last update, and completion events. Ownership is enforced: only the creating user can access, modify, or delete each Todo. The table provides full history for business reporting and supports independent CRUD operations, real-time task updates, and secure privacy boundaries. No Todo can exist without a valid user owner (linked through a required foreign key). Business rules ensure no duplicate titles per user among active (incomplete) Todos. Permanent deletion aligns with business requirements (no soft-delete). All user interactions and modifications are logged via timestamps for accountability and metrics.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the Todo item.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner of this Todo. Foreign key; strict privacy enforcement. References {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Required task summary. 1–100 chars. Business-validated; must not be empty or blank.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer detail or notes. Up to 500 chars. May be null if not provided by user.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Whether this Todo is finished (true) or still pending (false). Business logic ensures only owner can update.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp. Records exact moment the Todo was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp; always reflects current and accurate Todo data.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Moment when Todo was marked completed; null if still pending.
